answer: Practically, the chain should fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because whisper only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, tundra is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any copper approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
